title: BEAD: signed eligible-entity award agreements rise from 44 to 50 in three weeks
summary: Between April 13 and May 4, 2026, NTIA approvals rose from 53 to 54, NIST approvals from 51 to 52, and signed and returned eligible-entity award agreements from 44 to 50, while all 56 final proposals remained submitted. Denominator: The same 56 BEAD eligible entities and four nested dashboard milestones at two dated observations.
